name: accountantai-load-tests
description: k6 load and smoke tests (TypeScript) for the AccountantAI backend

scripts.setup: node -e "const f=require('fs'),p='.env';if(!f.existsSync(p)){f.copyFileSync('.env.example',p);console.log('created .env from .env.example — fill it in')}else{console.log('.env already exists')}"
scripts.smoke: npm run build && node run.mjs dist/smoke
scripts.load: npm run build && node run.mjs dist/load
scripts.smoke:health: npm run build && node run.mjs dist/smoke/health.smoke.test.js
scripts.smoke:me: npm run build && node run.mjs dist/smoke/me.smoke.test.js
scripts.smoke:connections: npm run build && node run.mjs dist/smoke/connections.smoke.test.js
scripts.smoke:drafts: npm run build && node run.mjs dist/smoke/drafts.smoke.test.js
scripts.smoke:webhook: npm run build && node run.mjs dist/smoke/webhook.smoke.test.js
scripts.smoke:approve: npm run build && node run.mjs dist/smoke/approve.opt.smoke.test.js
scripts.load:health: npm run build && node run.mjs dist/load/health.load.test.js
scripts.load:me: npm run build && node run.mjs dist/load/me.load.test.js
scripts.load:connections: npm run build && node run.mjs dist/load/connections.load.test.js
scripts.load:webhook: npm run build && node run.mjs dist/load/webhook.load.test.js
